chapter.verse: Tua thute khit ciangin aana a lian mahmah a nei vantungmi khat in vantung pan pusuakin a hong kumsuk ka mu hi. Lei in ama vangliatna tawh a taang hi.
Amah in, “Babilon khuapi a cim hi, a cim hi! Dawigilote’ omna, kihhuai kha khempeuh kikhumna, kihhuai leh gilo vasate kikhumna a suak zo hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua khuapi in a bawl nu leh pa mawhna bawlna leenggahzu hangin mipawl khempeuh kipukin a kisia uh hi. Leitung kumpite in zong amah tawh a mawh uh a, ama hauh luat-na hangin leitungah a om sumbukte in a hauh lawh uh hi,” ci-in nakpi aw tawh a kiko hi.
Tua lai takin vantung pan aw khat ka zak in, “Ka mipawlte aw, tua khuapi gilohnate tawh na kipawl loh nading uh ahi zongin, ama pulnatnate na thuak loh nading uh ahi zongin, pusuakin hong paikhia un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua khuapi-a gitlohnate in vantung dongin tung a, Pasian in tua gitlohna thute a phawk zo hi.
Amah in mi a piak bangin piakik in. Ama gamtatna a zahnih thukkik in. Ama bawl hai, amah ading a zahnih bawlsak in.

Amah in ama pumpi pahtawi-in nopsakna a khan’ mah bangin, nakpi-a bawlsiatna leh kahna kikona thuaksak in. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in, “Kei kumpinu ka hi hi, meigongnu ka hi kei hi. Cikmah hunin ka kap ngei kei ding hi,” ci-in a lungsim sungah a kingaihsun hi.

Tua ahih ciangin ama gimna ahi sihna, kahna, kikona, kialpite in ni khat sungin a tung ding uh hi. Amah zong mei in a kang tum khin ding hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, ama tungah thu a khen Topa Pasian in a vanglian ahi hi.
“Amah tawh mawhin nopsakna a ngah ngei leitung kumpite in zong tua khua-ah mei katna pan a pusuak meikhu a muh uh ciangin,

tua khua in a thuak gimna kihta-in gamlapi pan ding-in ‘Babilon khuapi, a to khuapi in gimna a thuak zo hi! Gimna a thuak zo hi! Nai khat sung bekinah thutanna na thuak ta hi,’ ci-in amah hangin kapin kiko-in a gen ding uh hi.”
“Leitungah a om sumbukte in zong amah hangin kapin a kiko uh hi.

Bang hang hiam i cih leh, kuamah in amaute sum ahi kham, ngun, a manpha suangte, suangmanpha, saihadial, puansan, nai puan leh puan eng; sahawk khum kung, saiha nate, amanpha sing tawh, sumngo tawh, sik tawh, suangkaang tawh kibawl kuangte;
kinnamon, masala, paknamtui, mirrah, paknamtui khal, leenggahzu, sathau, buhneel, mangbuh, bawng, tuu, sakol, leeng, sila, mi nuntakna kha pumpite cikmah hunin kuamah in a lei nawn kei ding hi.
Tua khuapi in a deih bel a gahte, a tehte-a kipan a hoih a kizang thei nek theihte mangthang khin ahih ciangin a nung ciang cikmah hunin kimu zo lo ding hi!
Tua sumte kizuak kilei-in, tua khuapi hangah hauhna a ngah sumbukte in tua khuapi in a thuak gimna kihta-in gamlapi pan ding-in,
“Saihadial, a san a eng puante, kham nate, a manpha suangte, suangmanphate, tawh a kizem khuapi lian in gimna a thuak hi, gimna a thuak hi!

Nai khat sung bekinah tua zaha nopsaknate a beisak ta hi,” ci-in kapin a kiko ding uh hi.” “Teembaw ukte khempeuh-a kipan tembaw tawh sum lei sum zuakte leh tembaw nasemte leh tuipi-ah nuntakna a zong mite in gamlapi pan ding-in,
tua khua meikatna pan a pusuak meikhu en in, ‘Tua khuapi tawh kua khua a kibang hiam?’ ci-in a gen khit uh ciangin,

a lutang uhah leivui kibuakin, “Tua khuapi lian in gimna a thuak hi, gimna a thuak hi.’ Ama na zat a manpha nate hangin tuipi tungah a pai tembaw a neite khempeuh in sum a hauhna uh khua, nai khat sunginah amah in a kisia ta hi,” ci-in kapin a kiko uh hi.
Vantung-a kipan misiangthote, sawltakte, kamsangte aw, tua khuapi hangin nuam un! Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian in note tawh kipawlin ama tungah thu a khen zo hi!” a ci hi.

Tua lai takin a thahat vantungmi khat in a lian angawina suang tawh kibang suang khat la-in tuipi sungah a khiatsuk ciangin, “Babilon khuapi lian in hih bangin nakpi khiatsukna thuakin a nung ciangin cikmah hunin kimu zo nawn lo ding hi.

Gawsem tumte, la siamte, tamngai tumte, peengkul tumte tumna’ aw nang sungah a nung ciangin cikmah hunin kiza nawn lo ding hi. Khutsiam pilna pawlte cikmah hunin nang sungah kimu nawn lo ding hi. An gawina ging nang sungah cikmah hunin kiza nawn lo ding hi.

Meivakna nang sungah cikmah hunin kivak nawn lo ding hi. Mo leh Mopipa’ aw nang sungah cikmah hunin kiza nawn lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, na sumbukte in leitung upate ahi ngei uh hi. Nangma bum theih siamna in zong mipawlte a kheem hi.
Kamsangte leh misiangthote’ sisan leh leitungah thahna a thuak mi khempeuh’ sisan tua khua-ah kimu zo hi,” a ci hi.
